entries.topicDescription: Diagnosing and improving app startup time, memory usage, and runtime performance.

tips.title: Baseline Profiles pre-compile hot code paths to speed up cold app startup
tips.content:
Without a Baseline Profile, the Android Runtime (ART) interprets and
JIT-compiles your app's code from scratch on every fresh install or app
update's first launches, which measurably slows down cold startup time
until the JIT has 'warmed up' the frequently-used code paths.

A Baseline Profile — a list of classes and methods known to be critical
to startup and common user flows — is shipped with the APK and lets ART
ahead-of-time compile those specific code paths at install time, giving
a faster cold start from the very first launch instead of only after
repeated JIT warm-up.
